from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Represents a party involved in the legal case."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party as named in the text")
    role: str = Field(description="Procedural role (e.g. Appellant, Appellee, Plaintiff, Defendant)")

class CourtIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Represents a court and case number found in the document."""
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Name of the court if extractable")
    case_number: str = Field(description="The official case number (e.g. (2023) 粤 0112 民初 5710 号)")
    year: Optional[str] = Field(description="Year associated with the case number")

class MonetaryItem(BaseModel):
    """Represents a specific monetary figure mentioned in the judgment."""
    label: str = Field(description="Description of the amount (e.g. Second instance fee, Compensation)")
    amount: float = Field(description="Numeric value of the amount")
    payer_or_payee: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who is responsible for paying or receiving")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(description="Additional context for the amount")

class DocumentEvidence(BaseModel):
    """Captures key extractable facts from a single legal judgment document."""
    document_type: str = Field(description="Type of document (e.g. Civil Judgment, Administrative Ruling)")
    case_cause: str = Field(description="Nature of the legal dispute")
    case_identifiers: list[CourtIdentifier] = Field(description="List of case numbers and courts mentioned")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of all named parties and their roles")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryItem] = Field(description="List of specific amounts, fees, and payments ordered")
    ruling_summary: str = Field(description="Short summary of the court's final decision/outcome")
    key_text_anchor: Optional[str] = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt supporting the ruling summary")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container aggregating extracted evidence from all documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentEvidence] = Field(description="List of extracted evidence objects for each document")
